adoption.new_or_modified_member_rule: no new or modified registered member may pass the ratchet without a valid survival declaration; certified and production members additionally require independently verified exact-release proof

model_invariant: A model may propose. It cannot authorize, mutate authoritative state, own identity, replace evidence, bypass queues or leases, or redefine release truth.
recovery_invariant: Identity, state, deterministic replay, queue ownership, lease fencing, receipts, authority and health semantics survive process restart, node replacement, model loss and model replacement.
release_invariant: candidate SHA = certified SHA = production SHA; survival declaration and proof metadata live outside the immutable candidate subject and bind back to it by exact digest
state_invariant: Authoritative state is external, durable, versioned and recoverable; in-memory state is never the sole institutional record.
